words.meaning: A place where children go to learn.
words.example: I go to school every day.

words.meaning: Pages with words and pictures. You read it.
words.example: I read a book before bed.

words.meaning: Furniture with a flat top and four legs. You eat your dinner on it.
A seat with legs and a back.
You write with it. It has ink inside.
words.example: I write with a blue pen.

words.meaning: You write and draw with it. A rubber can take away what you made.
A small thing that rubs out pencil marks. Also called a rubber.
words.example: I need an eraser to fix my mistake.

words.meaning: You carry things in it.
words.example: My books are in my bag.

words.meaning: Sticky stuff. You use it to stick paper together.
words.example: I stick the picture with glue.

words.meaning: A tool with two sharp blades. You cut paper with it.
words.example: I cut the paper with scissors.

words.meaning: A group of letters that means something, like "cat".
A drawing or photo of something.
words.example: Look at my picture of a dog!

words.meaning: Not new. Not young. Grandma and grandpa are this.
A child who will grow up to be a woman.
A child who will grow up to be a man.
A word for a girl or a woman. "___ is my sister."
words.example: This is Anna. She is six.

words.meaning: A word for a boy or a man. "___ is my dad."
words.example: This is Tom. He is my brother.

words.meaning: A question word. "___ are you?"
What you say when you meet someone.
What you say when you leave.
Not closed. You do this to a door to go in.
Shut. The opposite of open.
Get up from your chair onto your feet.
Put your bottom on a chair.
What you ask when you want to know a person's name.
